data.narrative:
Gambit is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Josh Giegel, Ben Richardson, and Andrew Kemendo that has raised $6.5M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage band, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $16M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector comparables spanning Seed and Series A stages with valuations ranging from $125M to $4.0B; the median valuation across this set is $1.0B, reflecting both the sector's capital intensity and stage variance within the peer group.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a wide range: $14M (low), $508M (median), and $1.1B (high). The substantial spread reflects material uncertainty inherent in early-stage valuation. The low end anchors to capital raised and near-term progression; the high end incorporates peer-derived multiples that skew toward later-stage, well-funded Defense & Security companies. Key variables driving final valuation include team execution, product differentiation within the crowded frontier-defense landscape, and customer traction relative to peer benchmarks.
